messages:
Alexa: heads up — thinking about a compact "fallback signal composer" for the rollout console. goal: let operators build an autofallback rule without diving into raw JSON. quick thoughts?
Ria: yes please. current editor is too many clicks. i want presets. :pray:
Omar: presets + preview + clear audit metadata. if we auto-fallback, we need a single event id that ties decision -> telemetry -> logs.
Leo: also needs a conservative default: soft-degrade preset that samples 10% and forwards to fallback quietly. avoids rush panic.
Marcus: agree. proposal: presets: soft-sample, hard-switch, quarantine. each preset exposes only 3 knobs in the composer: trigger, sample_rate, ttl.
Alexa: exactly. trigger ideas: 5xx spike, latency p95 > Xms, model-quality-regression (from eval webhook). also allow combined triggers (AND/OR).
Ria: combined triggers are important. e.g., (p95>500ms AND error_rate>3%). UI should show a short human readable summary.
Omar: audit requirements: every autofallback must record: event_id, applied_by (system/operator), trigger_snapshot (metrics), sample_inputs (optional redacted), policy_snapshot. must be queryable from console.
Leo: +1 on redaction flag. we should default to redact inputs unless operator explicitly toggles. sensitive routes need to stay private.
Marcus: how about operator overrides? need sticky-override that expires (TTL) and writes to audit with reason. also ability to snapshot and rollback to previous policy.
Alexa: UX: composer modal with three columns: left triggers, mid knobs, right preview + audit sample. include a dry-run toggle that shows hypotheticals and estimated QPS impact.
Omar: can we show estimated cost delta? e.g., fallback to smaller model -> tokens cost -20% but latency +40ms. even a ballpark helps decisions.
Ria: for triggers, simple DSL in UI — but we should surface raw policy JSON for advanced users. under the hood we store normalized policy with an id.
Marcus: sample policy JSON (for backend) — please keep small for preview:
```
{
  "id": "autofb-2026-03-21-01",
  "triggers": [{"type":"p95","op":">","value":500}],
  "mode": "soft-sample",
  "sample_rate": 0.1,
  "ttl_seconds": 3600
}
```
Leo: perfect. make sure rollout-bot emits a message when a policy is activated and link to audit entry. rollouts should include a trace id.
rollout-bot: policy autofallback "autofb-2026-03-21-01" enabled by Alexa. audit://autofb-2026-03-21-01
Ria: question: how do quotas play here? if fallback routes to dedicated reserved capacity, we might need to reserve headroom. composer should warn about quota mismatch.
Omar: preflight checks: compatibility matrix between source model and fallback model (schema, tokens, api). if mismatch, block or require acknowledge.
Alexa: good point. add a preflight step in composer that runs simulation for last 5m of traffic and shows sample diffs.
Marcus: also surface a small timeline in audit: when triggered, what fraction of requests hit fallback, operator actions, end state. must be exportable.
Leo: final ask: add a tiny 'why did I fallback' tooltip on request trace with links to the audit entry. supports SRE blameless postmortems.
Alexa: love it. i'll mock a quick Figma for the modal and the JSON payloads. can someone take a look before EOD? @Omar @Ria
Omar: can do, will review at 3pm PST.
Ria: I'll check the audit schema and redaction flows.
Marcus: i'll prototype the preflight simulation script.
Alexa: thanks all — i'll drop the figma + brief in the design thread. if anyone wants a quick 20m sync, ping here and i'll schedule. :calendar:
